scene.note: The night's values sit at the top of radio_watch.py, and your while loops keep going until the job is done, and no longer.

steps.note: Dougie's countdown starts from the minutes until the vehicle leaves.
Under Task 1 the loop asks the same question on every round, and nothing inside it changes the answer.
Once each round brings the answer closer, the countdown ends and the vehicle leaves.
The radio starts with a charge and loses some every hour.
Under Task 2 a loop takes away an hour's drain and counts the hour, round after round.
It stops as soon as the charge is below the mark, and Ailsa has the hours.
The hill is split into numbered squares, searched in order.
Under Task 3 each round searches one square and asks whether it is the one.
The search ends when the walker is found, or when the squares run out.
The radio has numbered channels, and the team already listens on one of them.
Under Task 4 each round calls one channel, and the team's own round is skipped.
Every other channel hears the call, once each, in order.
